scope: Read-only design review; no signing, APK build, upload, workflow dispatch or production edits performed

originalTarget.basis: Previously preserved signing receipt and signed-package audit; large APK not downloaded or re-audited in this review

conclusion: A separate tightly scoped Observer-only signing workflow is feasible. The existing generic sign command and sign_observer validator must not be invoked for the new Observer, and the ordinary original-artifact verifier must remain unchanged.

existingInterfaces.credentials: Existing workflow passes only PURETV_KEYSTORE_BASE64 and PURETV_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD to its signing step. This review inspected interface names only; no values or private key files were read.
existingInterfaces.signer: android-release.py source() binds HEAD to GITHUB_SHA; pin() reads the checked-in fixed certificate digest. sign_file() zipaligns, signs with alias puretv and password env references, checks alignment and exact non-META-INF content equivalence. Existing flags enable v1/v2/v3 and disable v4.
existingInterfaces.genericSignerRejected: sign() first validates and then signs every selected game APK plus its old Observer. sign_observer()/validate_observer() require com.ecojust.joystickqa.backroadrally, old /status+/snapshot endpoints and the old Observer source inventory.
existingInterfaces.originReader: android-runtime-artifact.py binds exact original workflow, run/attempt/source, unique signed artifact and successful build/sign producer; validates full original ZIP digest and every extracted byte.
existingInterfaces.ordinaryInputVerifier: android-runtime-inputs.py verifies original signed game and old Observer, complete original Git inputs/payload/signature, and unchanged current production/old Observer bytes. It intentionally cannot relabel a newly built diagnostic Observer as original.

requirements: Use a new fixed workflow source SHA, preferably an isolated child of original 4b6 with only explicitly reviewed diagnostic files and necessary helper/workflow additions.
No arbitrary game/package/artifact/source/release inputs. The original target identity above is constant. Exact checkout HEAD must equal GITHUB_SHA.

Retain original production, SDK and old Observer bytes. Run unchanged ordinary input verification; any legitimate closure mismatch must be explained and handled by an exact minimal QA checkout, never a bypass.
Record full exact source closure for new Java/JS/build, signing helper and imported verifier/build modules, workflow, certificate pin and diagnostic runner.

proposedWorkflow.stage: Build and sign the separate test Observer only
requirements: Build com.ecojust.joystickgraphicsqa.backroadrally with instrumentation com.ecojust.graphicsqa.GraphicsObserver targeting exactly com.ecojust.joystick.backroadrally. Require committed source byte equality, testOnly=true, minSdk26/targetSdk35, INTERNET only and the expected manifest/component.

Prefer a build/sign job with unsigned build and tests before its only secret-bearing signing step, avoiding a separate unbound unsigned-artifact handoff. Runtime runs in another job without signing secrets.

Before loading any key: validate safe unique ZIP members, exact expected APK contents, bounded bytes, source/build receipt/class or DEX identities, manifest and absence of an existing signer. Do not merely trust receipt booleans.

Reuse the existing fixed certificate, alias and env-password interface; key only in a mode0600 temporary file, deleted on all exits. Do not log secrets or store keys. Validate exported certificate hash before signing.

Only the new test APK is passed to zipalign/apksigner. Never call generic android-release.py sign, build a target APK or sign any target package. Use bounded subprocess/job deadlines and exact non-META-INF content equality after signing.

Emit a new independent test-only signing receipt with source SHA/run/attempt, original target identity, unsigned and signed bytes/SHA, expected manifest/certificate, source/build hashes and testArtifactOnly=true; not an original-game signing receipt.
Upload the new signed test Observer plus receipts under an unmistakable diagnostic artifact name; no Release, app directory, market, publish or acceptance output.

proposedWorkflow.stage: Bind and run diagnostics without target changes
requirements: Fetch the original artifact once with the existing reader and verify its exact full ZIP SHA/size/producer. Re-run unchanged ordinary input verification for original game and original Observer. Original identities remain distinct from the new Observer.

Separately verify the new Observer artifact/producer/source/build/sign receipt/certificate and signed APK exact SHA before installation. Recompute original target APK bytes/SHA immediately before and after use.

Install the verified original APK unchanged and install the distinct testOnly graphics Observer with -t. Start only its exact instrumentation component, and keep the original Observer validated but not concurrently started.

Use only the declared loopback diagnostic port63487 and bounded GET /status,/console,/graphics; explicitly report that this observer omits old /snapshot and is not a drop-in ordinary runner Observer. Do not rewrite the old run.py or ordinary binding result.

Drive any reproduction through unchanged SDK input and original menus, keeping independent actual ACK/session/sequence logs. Read cached state without a second consuming native poll; no model writes, clock overrides, GL context calls, synthetic gameplay, network asset substitutions or automatic resume.
Preserve chosen emulator/API/GPU/Vulkan settings as explicit separately controlled inputs; do not silently mix an environment change with instrumentation.

Record oldObserverValidatedButNotStarted and actualDiagnosticInstrumentationComponent separately. A test-only aggregate report must distinguish originalGameSource, diagnosticObserverSource and diagnosticRunnerSource, including all hashes/run identities.

Preserve all failures, raw console/resource/layout observations, actual screenshots and any visual blank-track outcome. Diagnostic completion never means gameplay accepted or APK publishable. Always collect bounded artifacts without keys, tokens or signed download URLs.

pendingIndependentReview: Driving has not yet frozen new graphics Observer/build/tests; no final behavior approval is claimed by this design.
Review bounded console fields/resource URLs and secret redaction, loopback-only GET parser/timeouts, UI thread timeouts, activity lifecycle and single existing-client-preserving console hook.
Review the proposed workflow/sign helper and test-only runner after freeze, including the exact original-artifact/Observer provenance boundary and unchanged target bytes.
requiredNegativeTests: Wrong original source/run/attempt/artifact/digest/certificate rejected before signing or installation.
New Observer package/target/component/testOnly/SDK/permissions/endpoint/source/content mismatch and changed payload during signing rejected.
Original Observer receipt cannot be replaced or relabeled; generic signer cannot be selected; arbitrary target or Release writes are absent.
Wrong new diagnostic source/producer/cert or stale/tampered unsigned/signed receipt rejected; unknown signing result cannot be reported as successful.
All diagnostics errors/timeouts preserve original result and failure evidence; no cached snapshot substituted as a new observation.
limitations: Design/source review only; no credentials inspected, APK operations, native execution or new signature produced.
Original signed APK and existing prior audit are referenced, not re-downloaded or reverified here.
Current Android publication remains paused for the unresolved actual blank-track image; diagnostic evidence does not override that decision.
